sloka: अथवा किम् ममैतेन राजद्रव्यमयेन तु ।उद्धृतम् मे स्वयम् तो यम् व्रतादेशम् करिष्यति ॥२-२२-२८॥
transliteration: athavā kim mamaitena rājadravyamayena tu ।uddhṛtam me svayam to yam vratādeśam kariṣyati ॥2-22-28॥

translations.english: Or else, for me what is the use of these pots of holy water which are the king's property? The water drawn with my own hands will be made use of for my religious bath.
